event_summary: A small silver wrench-shaped object moves across the front edge of a black circular object and then is no longer visible.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a wooden tabletop with a black circular low cylinder on the right, a small metallic angled object with a purple hanging strip on the left, and a black cord extending behind the cylinder. At the start, a silver wrench-shaped piece is visible across the front-right edge of the black cylinder. During the early and middle portion, the silver piece changes position along the front edge of the cylinder toward the left while its angle also changes. Near the later portion, the silver piece is briefly near the left-front edge of the cylinder and then disappears from view. The black cylinder, cord, and left metallic object remain visually in place.

reasons: The black circular object, the silver wrench-shaped object, the left metallic object, and the purple strip are all visible.
The silver wrench-shaped object is already positioned at the front-right edge of the black circular object in the first frame.
